$comment: Schema and example for docs/DESIGN/adr/ADR-NNNN-*.json. One file per load-bearing decision. Read by sprint plan (consultation) and design refresh (consistency check).
title: Short title describing the decision
context: 1-2 paragraphs of prose describing the forces at play. What problem are we solving? What constraints exist? Why is this decision needed now?

alternatives.name: Alternative option name
alternatives.tradeoff: One-line description of why this alternative was or wasn't chosen

decision: One sentence describing what was chosen, clearly and unambiguously
consequences: Note about something that follows from this decision
supersedes: ADR-NNNN that this replaces, or null
superseded_by: ADR-NNNN that replaces this, or null
notes: Anything else worth recording (optional). Often: 'Revisit if X happens.'
